## Checklist

- [ ] Did not fabricate benchmark numbers
- [ ] Did not weaken or delete tests to get CI green
- [ ] Did not special-case a dataset
- [ ] Frozen Phase 1/2 semantics are unchanged, or the compatibility impact is explained
- [ ] Performance PRs include before/after numbers from the same protocol
